scientific_conclusion: Within the frozen controlled Fakeddit validation setting, M4qcf demonstrated consistent reliability-informed fusion adaptation to single-modality degradation (H8-F supported). However, this mechanistic adaptation did not satisfy the preregistered consistency requirement for robustness improvement over M1b across corruption conditions (H9-F not supported), and compatibility-driven interaction suppression did not reduce mismatch-induced classification degradation relative to M1b under the preregistered H10-F criterion (H10-F not supported). These findings distinguish successful internal reliability adaptation from demonstrated downstream robustness benefit.
